title: tx_queue.c: tx_queue_stats_get missing lock violates documented API contract
description:
Line 435: The header (tx_queue.h:215-216) promises 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' but the implementation copies the 24-byte stats struct without holding the lock. A concurrent push/pop modifying stats fields can produce torn reads where some counters reflect pre-operation values and others post-operation. The implementation comment acknowledges this non-atomicity, contradicting the public API documentation. Either add lock_queue/unlock_queue around the copy, or correct the header documentation.

File: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 435
close_reason: Fixed: Added lock_queue/unlock_queue around stats copy in tx_queue_stats_get() to match the documented API contract of thread-safe atomic copy. Removed misleading comment about non-atomicity. All 22 tx_queue tests pass.
